name: artifact-0921-celestial-star
scope: Artifact 921 and Effect 402 on a frozen flat test world. Fixture uses explicit first_join, Believe.Flora, survival players with max_health base 100, direct /damage and HPRegenCooldown reset for heal measurement, and angel sandbag 10012 summoned after players are counted (HP above 9000) for damage deltas. Clicks are fed through ClickCarrotEvent so the real player tick, artifact trigger, cooldown and Effect tick run. Checks that daytime use is rejected, the longRange/heal type cooldown settings, placement position, starfield object 1197 creation on detonation (at max stage 5 objects with 24 nebula and 40 constellation line text displays including back copies; at stage 1 only 2 objects without constellation lines) and removal after its lifetime (not rendering), power-up timing, detonation window at 20.5s, damage/heal amounts and ranges, stage-1 multiplier, and expiry. Particles and sounds are not checked (client does not render).

steps.name: Fixture: players, wall and artifact
commands: execute as @a at @s run function core:handler/first_join
data modify storage api: Argument.Heal set value 100f
data modify storage api: Argument.FixedHeal set value true
execute as StarAlly run function api:heal/
execute as StarFar run function api:heal/
data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 921
execute as StarUser at @s run function api:artifact/give/from_id
execute if data entity StarUser SelectedItem.tag.TSB{ID:921}

steps.name: Let the fixture settle
Allies start at full health of 100
expect: StarAlly has the following entity data: 100\.0f
StarFar has the following entity data: 100\.0f

steps.name: Summon sandbags after players are counted
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 10012
data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 10012
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star NearCount int 1 if entity @e[tag=StarNear]
execute store result score #near_initial devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health

steps.name: Click in the daytime
Process the daytime click
Daytime click neither places the star nor starts GCD
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect

steps.name: Place the star with a real click
Process the placement tick
Placement creates Effect 402 at stack 1 in front of the wall and starts GCD
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id

steps.name: Advance to 79 ticks after placement
Still stack 1 just before 4 seconds; floating lights keep three states within range
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star BugCount int 1 if data storage api: Return.Effect.Field.Bugs[]
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect.Field.Bugs[].Distance

steps.name: Advance to 80 ticks after placement
Stack 2 at 4 seconds
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id

steps.name: Advance to 409 ticks after placement
Stack 6 with one tick left; record HP before detonation
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute store result score #near_before devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
execute store result score #outside_before devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
expect: StarAlly has the following entity data: 20\.0f
StarFar has the following entity data: 20\.0f

steps.name: Detonate at 410 ticks after placement (last tick of 20.5s)
Detonation queues targets by 1m distance bands; a second click during the wave is ignored
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star QueueSize int 1 if data storage api: Return.Effect.Field.Detonation.Queue[]
execute store result score #near_mid devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star Starfields int 1 if entity @e[type=item_display,scores={ObjectID=1197}]
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star Glyphs int 1 if entity @e[type=text_display,tag=1197.Glyph]
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star Lines int 1 if entity @e[type=text_display,tag=1197.Line]
expect:
contents: 5
Test passed, count: 1
[^
]*contents: 5
Test passed, count: 1
[^
]*contents: 8
Test passed, count: 1

steps.name: Advance the wave to 4m
Targets at 4-5m are not hit before the wave reaches them
commands: execute store result score #near_mid devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
expect: StarAlly has the following entity data: 20\.0f

steps.name: Advance the wave to 6m
The wave at 6m damages the enemy and heals the ally together
commands: execute store result score #near_after devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star Starfields int 1 if entity @e[type=item_display,scores={ObjectID=1197}]
expect: StarAlly has the following entity data: 60\.0f

steps.name: Advance the wave to 8m
Outside targets are untouched and the star is removed after the last band
commands: execute store result score #outside_after devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect
expect: StarFar has the following entity data: 20\.0f

steps.name: Wait for GCD (1200) and heal TCD (600) to end
Starfield objects and their text displays are gone after their lifetime
Place again
Process second placement
Second placement exists; record HP; click again on the next tick
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute store result score #near_before devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health

steps.name: Detonate one tick after placement and process the queue
Stage 1 deals 3000, removes the star, and shows the starfield without constellations
commands: execute store result score #near_after devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect
execute store result storage devspace_verify:star Starfields int 1 if entity @e[type=item_display,scores={ObjectID=1197}]
expect: star has the following contents: 2\nTest passed(?!,)

steps.name: Wait for GCD (1200) and heal TCD (600) to end again
Place a star that will expire
Process third placement and wait 410 ticks
Star is gone 410 ticks after placement; click at 411 does not detonate
commands: data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect
execute store result score #near_before devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health

steps.name: Process the late click
Late click neither detonates nor places during cooldown
commands: execute store result score #near_after devspace_verify run data get storage api: Return.Health
data modify storage api: Argument.ID set value 402
execute as StarUser run function api:entity/mob/effect/get/from_id
execute unless data storage api: Return.Effect
